title: Pomerado — Build Deterministic Website-to-MCP Integrations with Browser Exploration
resourceType: Open-source MIT local MCP integration minter / native Playwright browser exploration / deterministic generated operation modules
purpose: 將缺乏公開 API、需要瀏覽器登入／二階段驗證的網站操作轉換為可重複執行的 MCP Tools：用自然語言描述網站與工作，Mint Agent 透過真實 Chromium／Playwright 瀏覽探索及建立 `src/` 操作模組；Guardian 在建立期間審核工具呼叫、操作及輸出程式，最後讓 Agent 經本機 MCP Server 調用生成的確定性程式，避免每一輪都重新以模型視覺操作網頁。
recommendation: 適合研究 Website → Tool → MCP 的 Agent 工具化方式，尤其只有 Web UI、沒有穩定公開 API 的服務。先選唯讀、低敏感度、可檢查的操作建立 Proof of Concept，檢查產出的程式、輸出 Schema 與網站權限，再逐步考慮修改流程。對付款、提交表單、編修、刪除等寫入操作，額外加上每次調用的使用者授權、Dry Run、冪等鍵／防重、操作日誌與實際結果核對，不可只依靠 Mint 時 Guardian 審查。
notes: 2026-10-28 核對官方 README、docs/how-it-works.md、docs/getting-started.md、docs/agent-setup.md、根目錄 LICENSE、package.json。官方主分支 package.json 版本 0.4.0，MIT 授權；README 註明 0.1.2 或更舊版為 AGPL-3.0-only、third-party adapted code 仍依各自條款。支援 Mac/Linux、Node 24.21+ 且低於 25、需 Playwright Chromium 與可用 OpenAI API key（建立和審核整合時使用 OpenAI 模型，與操控 Pomerado 的 Claude/Codex/其他 Agent 可不同）；啟動服務和列工具不會使用模型，Mint 呼叫才涉及費用／真實瀏覽。流程 Mint Agent → Chromium／Native Playwright 探索和完成一個範例 → 整理成 src/* 確定性 operation modules → Guardian 行為與 Publication Review、read 筆案例驗證 → 輸出 pomerado.json/schema、deployment.json、MCP 啟動程式、部署／驗證紀錄，讓每次後續 Tool Run 執行生成程式、不需再呼叫模型。Minter 的 `mint/get_job/provide_input/cancel_job` 分別啟動、追進度、答疑和停止工作；官方 Read／Write Authority 在 Mint 時選擇，Write Mint 會實際操作一次，可能對真實網站產生效果，Cancel 亦不保證已送出的動作可撤回；Read Mint 若認為必須寫入會請求升級。重要限制（官方 README 直述）：『A run doesn't check authority or intent, and edits to src/ or deployment.json aren't reviewed』；日後 Run 若是可寫 Tool，並不會再次強制使用者批准，每次高後果操作應由外部 Host／Human-in-the-Loop 控制；自架 MCP 整合可能因網站改版、權限、驗證碼、bot protection 而失效。登入資料由使用者在網站上提供，官網表示不儲存值，但不檢查網站本身 script 將所輸入內容送往何處；只檢查登入表單／提交 Origin，故使用前應評估 phishing、網站腳本與不可信頁面注入。完整 MIT 原始核心包含 Minter、Guardian、runtime、local host；Pomerado Cloud 另提供託管、OAuth／儲存登入、Access Control、Bot Protection、Repair 等服務，不能把 Cloud 功能誤認為免費本機版內建。作者的『deterministic / faster / more reliable than computer use』是官方設計主張，本輪未執行基準測試或安全審計。勿隨便把 Pomerado 連到內部 HR、財務等敏感系統，需依組織政策與合約核准。沒有安裝、執行 CLI、連接網站、登入、讀取金鑰或操作外部系統。

phases.details: User names target URL, concrete task, example inputs and read/write authority. Write authority must be deliberately approved before Mint.
Model-driven Mint Agent explores real Chromium with Playwright, completes concrete example(s), writes deterministic operation modules to src/ and creates input/output schema.

Guardian screens edits/browser actions during build and reviews publication. Read integrations may run generated live tests. Tests and guardian gates belong to build-time, not guaranteed per future call.
Generates pomerado.json, src/, deployment.json, auth-fill.json when signed in, mcp.mjs, mcp.json, README.md; source code saved in user's chosen local folder.
Runs generated operations through local MCP server, without another OpenAI model call. Agent invokes integration as a tool; authentication may be requested each run.
Optional hosted Pomerado Cloud offers integration hosting, saved logins/OAuth brokerage, permissions and site-breakage repair. Not included automatically in local runtime.

safety.mintRead: Choose read for access that only observes site data; if action requires mutation, confirm upgrade before creating it.
safety.mintWrite: Write mint performs one example operation against the site during build. Cancellation cannot roll back an already sent action.
safety.invocationBoundary: Generated integration Run does not independently recheck authority/intent. Modifying src/ or deployment.json bypasses Mint-time Guardian review.
safeguardsRecommended: Require authorization and explicit confirmation at call time for high-impact writes
Review generated code and its network/credential handling
Keep separate low-permission test accounts and read-only proof-of-concept
Verify final state before retrying ambiguous writes
Audit scopes, data transfers and destination scripts

architecture.runtimeRequirements: macOS or Linux; Node 24.21.x–24.x; Playwright Chromium; OpenAI API key for Mint; local MCP stdio host.
architecture.status: First-party documented implementation; no runtime or actual website tests conducted.
